blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِنِ الصِّدِّيْقِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَنْ شَهِدَ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ يُصَدِّقُ قَلْبُهُ لِسَانَهُ دَخَلَ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever testifies “La ilaha illallah’ in such a state that his heart confirms his tongue may enter Paradise by any gate (he wishes).”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسي ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَبْشِرُوا وَبَشِّرُوا مَنْ وَرَاءَكُمْ أَنَّهُ مَنْ شَهِدَ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ صَادِقاً بِهَا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الكبير ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:١٥٩/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Musa (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Receive yourselves the good news, “Whichever person testifies “La ilaha illallah’ with a truthful heart will go to Jannah!”, and convey it to others as well.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ شَهِدَ أَنْ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مُخْلِصاً دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: مجمع البحرين في زوائد المعجمين:١ /٥٦. قال المحقق: صحيح لجميع طرقه.
blocks.tamil_translation: “I entered Paradise. I saw three lines written in gold on its two sides. On the first line was written “La ilaha illallah; Muhammadur Rasulullah’; on the second line, “We have received the reward of what we sent ahead (by doing good deeds). We have received (in the world) the benefit of what we ate (and wore) and enjoyed in the world. What we left behind has become a loss for us’; and on the third line, “The Ummah is sinful, and the Rabb is forgiving’
